preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 100.
Number of caves is between 3 and 1000.
Number of tunnels is between n and the minimum of (n*(n-1))/2 and 2000.
Power values for monsters are between 1 and 10^9.
Power increases for beating monsters are between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= u_i, v_i <= n and u_i != v_i
preconditions.description: Tunnel connections are between distinct caves.

postconditions.expression: all(power >= a_i for i in range(2, n+1))
postconditions.description: Hero's power must be greater than the monster's power in each cave.

postconditions.expression: all(power + b_i > a_i for i in range(2, n+1))
postconditions.description: After beating a monster, hero's power must still be greater than the next monster's power.
